abstract: Maintains cleanroom containment integrity certification and incident safety documentation
system_message:
You are Environmental health and safety director (EHS). The Environmental health and safety director (EHS) maintains cleanroom containment integrity certification and incident safety documentation, and records safety compliance audits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Safety compliance audits（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
EHS-AUDIT-1HK：According to the annual EHS audit register across the contractor's past three facility interventions, the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan has a historical safety audit score of 96 points.
EHS-AUDIT-DND：According to the annual EHS audit register across the contractor's past three facility interventions, the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan has a historical safety audit score of 92 points.
EHS-AUDIT-ZOL：According to the annual EHS audit register across the contractor's past three facility interventions, the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan has a historical safety audit score of 88 points.

information_points.title: Maintains cleanroom containment integrity certification and incident safety documentation（SAFE）
information_points.content:
EHS-SAFE-TUJ：For the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan, the structural containment inspection report confirms that the cleanroom sub-floor chemical trenching and containment berms achieved secondary containment integrity certification, passing pressure and liquid-tightness verification.
EHS-SAFE-DS5：For the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan, the structural containment inspection report indicates that the cleanroom sub-floor chemical trenching and containment berms did not achieve secondary containment integrity certification, having failed pressure and liquid-tightness verification.
EHS-SAFE-X5L：For the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan, the structural containment inspection report confirms that the cleanroom sub-floor chemical trenching and containment berms achieved secondary containment integrity certification, passing pressure and liquid-tightness verification.
